description: One company’s tokenized stock SIDE BY SIDE across issuers and networks, by ticker, company name or ISIN: supply, value at the issuer’s reference, pool premium, DEX liquidity, pause state, holders and the largest holder, reserves where reported, and each token’s buy-check status with its cautions. Each row is a different wrapper with its own controls. Free.

q.description: A ticker, company name or ISIN, e.g. TSLA, Tesla or US88160R1014.

name: compare_stock_tokens

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

tokens.description: One row per token, each with valueUsd on the supply outside the issuer, supplyStatus, valueBasis, valueUpperBoundUsd, valuationComplete, valuationFresh, priceAgeSeconds, referenceKind and waterfall (grossMinted, issuerInventory, circulatingExIssuer, distributedToExternalHolders, block, sameBlock). SINCE 2026-11-28 (plugin audit P1-8) each row also carries multiplier, readBlocks {kind block | slot, supplyBlock, inventoryBlock, custodyBlock, custodyRead, sameBlock, gap, state same_block | block_gap | not_read | no_inventory_read, says}; reserveLevels {issuer_reported {state read | published_not_read | none, what, source, backingRatio, asOf}, auditor_attested {state none_read | read, firm, source}, independently_verified {state not_verified, why}, solvencyScore null, says}; prices {tokenMarketPrice, underlyingSharePrice {usd per share, perTokenUsd (null where the multiplier is not read: never taken as 1), multiplier, multiplierStatus read | in_balance_by_issuer_terms | not_read}, nav, referenceKind, means}.

units.description: The multiplier test across issuers; each token carries multiplierStatus, and multiplierNotRead counts priced tokens left out because no multiplier was read (never taken as 1).

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Compare one company’s tokenized stocks
